scripts.contracts: pnpm --filter contracts exec tsx src/emit.ts && pnpm contracts:py
scripts.contracts:py: datamodel-codegen --input packages/contracts/dist/schema/Trajectory.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output apps/runner/evalgate/trajectory_models.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel && datamodel-codegen --input packages/contracts/dist/schema/ScoreResult.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output apps/runner/evalgate/score_models.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel
